name: multisystemic smooth muscle dysfunction syndrome
description: Multisystemic smooth muscle dysfunction syndrome is a disease in which the activity of smooth muscle throughout the body is impaired. This leads to widespread problems including blood vessel abnormalities, a decreased response of the pupils to light, a weak bladder, and weakened contractions of the muscles used for the digestion of food (hypo peristalsis). A certain mutation in the ACTA2 gene has been shown to cause this condition insome individuals.
